_meta: 터키어 회화 음성 — 목소리·감정·자리 채움. 일본어앱 data/tts/voices.json 과 같은 틀. 터키어는 성별로 말이 안 바뀌어 남·여판 차이는 이름뿐.
base_text: Bugün öğleden sonra toplantım var, o yüzden belgeleri şimdiden hazırlıyorum. Sonra birlikte akşam yemeğine gidelim mi?

am.desc: A young Turkish man in his twenties, clear and gentle voice, standard Istanbul accent

af.desc: A young Turkish woman in her twenties, clear and soft voice, standard Istanbul accent

elif.desc: A Turkish woman in her early twenties, bright, quick and talkative voice, slightly playful

can.desc: A Turkish man in his early twenties, relaxed, easygoing and mischievous voice

zeynep.desc: A Turkish woman in her early twenties, calm, low-key and thoughtful voice

emre.desc: A Turkish man in his mid twenties, deep, direct and quietly warm voice

staff.desc: A Turkish woman in her twenties, polite, clear service voice

waiter.desc: A Turkish man in his thirties, polite, brisk restaurant waiter voice

vendor.desc: A Turkish man in his fifties, loud, cheerful bazaar-vendor voice

taxi.desc: A Turkish man in his forties, rough, chatty taxi driver voice

teyze.desc: A Turkish woman in her fifties, warm, talkative neighbourhood auntie voice

boss.desc: A Turkish woman in her forties, composed, firm but kind voice

hoca.desc: A Turkish man in his fifties, calm, articulate professor voice

mom.desc: A Turkish woman in her fifties, warm, caring mother's voice

dad.desc: A Turkish man in his fifties, deep, steady father's voice

man_y.desc: A Turkish man around twenty, natural and clear voice

man_m.desc: A Turkish man in his forties, steady and calm voice

man_o.desc: A Turkish man in his seventies, aged and gentle voice

woman_y.desc: A Turkish woman around twenty, natural and clear voice

woman_m.desc: A Turkish woman in her forties, composed and kind voice

woman_o.desc: A Turkish woman in her seventies, aged and warm voice

kid.desc: A Turkish child around eight years old, high and lively voice

announce.desc: A Turkish woman, neutral public-announcement voice, even and clear

neutral.instruct: calm and natural, everyday tone, natural conversational pace, subtle
neutral.ref: Bugün öğleden sonra toplantı var, o yüzden belgeleri şimdiden hazırlıyorum.

polite.instruct: polite and professional, like a clerk or station staff, natural conversational pace, subtle
polite.ref: Hoş geldiniz efendim, buyurun. Size nasıl yardımcı olabilirim? Teşekkür ederiz.

stiff.instruct: very nervous and stiff, formal and overly polite, natural conversational pace, subtle
stiff.ref: Zaman ayırdığınız için çok teşekkür ederim. Elimden geleni yapacağım efendim.

cheerful.instruct: cheerful, bright and friendly, natural conversational pace, subtle
cheerful.ref: Ay geldin mi? Süper! Bugün hava da çok güzel, keyfim yerinde!

amused.instruct: amused, laughing warmly, relaxed, natural conversational pace, subtle
amused.ref: Çok komiksin ya! Tamam tamam, öyle yapalım, güldürme beni.

teasing.instruct: teasing, playful and mischievous, natural conversational pace, subtle
teasing.ref: Ne o, yüzün kızardı mı? Hadi söyle, kimseye demem, söz.

excited.instruct: excited, bursting with energy, bright and loud, natural conversational pace, subtle
excited.ref: Oldu! Başardım! İnanamıyorum, gerçekten çok mutluyum!

surprised.instruct: surprised, caught off guard, voice jumps, natural conversational pace, subtle
surprised.ref: Ne? Gerçekten mi? Bir dakika, o ne demek şimdi?

shout.instruct: raised voice, comic disbelief, not screaming, natural conversational pace, subtle
shout.ref: Ne? Şimdi mi? Ben ne yapacağım peki?

tsukkomi.instruct: a quick sharp comic retort, exasperated but fond, natural conversational pace, subtle
tsukkomi.ref: Hayır, öyle değil! Neden burada yapıyorsun bunu? Ne alaka şimdi ya!

annoyed.instruct: annoyed, irritated, sighing, natural conversational pace, subtle
annoyed.ref: Of ya, yine mi bu konu? Artık yeter, konuşmayalım şunu.

sad.instruct: sad, quiet, voice slightly trembling, natural conversational pace, subtle
sad.ref: Sadece biraz yoruldum. Önemli bir şey yok.

worried.instruct: worried and anxious, hesitant, natural conversational pace, subtle
worried.ref: İyi misin? Doktora gitsek mi acaba?

flustered.instruct: flustered and embarrassed, stammering, unsure, natural conversational pace, subtle

shy.instruct: shy, soft, slightly trailing off, natural conversational pace, subtle
shy.ref: Şey… ben de seni… yani… o zaman, birlikte gidelim mi…

gentle.instruct: gentle, warm and tender, quiet, natural conversational pace, subtle
gentle.ref: Sorun yok, yavaş yavaş yaparsın. Ben buradayım, merak etme.
